summary: Combine items, meet odd characters, and crack the Funky Island case.
description:
CAN YOU SOLVE THE MYSTERY OF FUNKY ISLAND? 🕵️‍♂️

Working as a detective seemed easy until I set foot on Funky Island. Hired by the mysterious Juliet to find the pieces of a map leading to her long-lost grandfather, I quickly realized this simple case was anything but. 🚤

CAPTIVATING STORY
Embark on a memorable adventure! Challenge a ghost pirate to a duel, help a mermaid with her musical career, and outsmart mischievous monkeys. Each twist and turn brings new surprises! 🐒🏴‍☠️🎤

BEAUTIFUL GRAPHICS
Explore hand-crafted levels with stunning animations and a unique art style that brings Funky Island to life. 🌴🎨

THRILLING GAMEPLAY
Combine objects, interact with quirky characters, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover hidden map pieces to progress. Every level is a new adventure! 🔍🧩

ATMOSPHERIC AUDIO
Immerse yourself in the game with custom soundtracks and ambient sounds. Best enjoyed with the sound on! 🎧

TRY FOR FREE
Play the first levels for free! Unlock additional levels and dive deeper into the story with the paid version. 📜🆓

SUPER WIDESCREEN SUPPORT
Enjoy the stunning graphics on 18:9 phones and tablets. The detailed cartoon graphics shine on every screen! 📱✨

If you love puzzle games, don’t miss this unforgettable challenge! Download now and experience the adventure! 🚀
